title: Exploring Feedstock Pathways to Three Billion Gallons of Sustainable Aviation Fuel: The Roles of Contracts and Bioenergy Crop Insurance
title_zh: 探索实现三十亿加仑可持续航空燃料的原料路径：合同与生物能源作物保险的作用
title_primary: 探索实现三十亿加仑可持续航空燃料的原料路径：合同与生物能源作物保险的作用
title_secondary: Exploring Feedstock Pathways to Three Billion Gallons of Sustainable Aviation Fuel: The Roles of Contracts and Bioenergy Crop Insurance
authors: Ruiqing Miao, Bijesh Mishra, Mohit Anand, Madhu Khanna, Fahd Majeed
official: 官方在线 2026-09-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how contracts and bioenergy crop yield insurance incentivize biomass supply for three billion gallons of sustainable aviation fuel. Results show that meeting feedstock demand by growing uninsured miscanthus requires a fixed biomass price at $78–$86/metric ton, a revenue share of 32%–36%, or a land‐leasing payment about $178/acre. Growing uninsured switchgrass requires similar terms. Bioenergy crop insurance partially substitutes for compensation for bearing production risk, decreasing required fixed prices and revenue shares by 4% (6%) for miscanthus (switchgrass), while having minimal impact on bioenergy crop acreage and average biomass production cost, but mixed effects on farmers' welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了合同与生物能源作物产量保险如何激励为30亿加仑可持续航空燃料供应生物质。结果表明，通过种植未投保的芒草来满足原料需求，需要将生物质固定价格设定为每公吨78–86美元、收入分成比例为32%–36%，或土地租赁付款约为每英亩178美元。种植未投保的柳枝稷需要类似条件。生物能源作物保险部分替代了对承担生产风险的补偿，使芒草（柳枝稷）所需的固定价格和收入分成比例降低4%（6%），同时对生物能源作物种植面积和平均生物质生产成本影响甚微，但对农民福利收益的影响则好坏参半。

title: The Watchful Eye: Government Accounting Supervision and Its Effects on Supply Chain Finance
title_zh: 警惕之眼：政府会计监督及其对供应链金融的影响
title_primary: 警惕之眼：政府会计监督及其对供应链金融的影响
title_secondary: The Watchful Eye: Government Accounting Supervision and Its Effects on Supply Chain Finance
authors: Haowen Tian, Hao Han, Junkai Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the impact of government accounting supervision on the adoption of supply chain finance (SCF) among Chinese listed firms. Using a difference‐in‐differences (DID) approach and a comprehensive dataset spanning 1999 to 2022, we find robust evidence that government accounting supervision significantly promotes the adoption of SCF. This relationship remains resilient across a battery of robustness checks, including parallel trend analysis, propensity score matching (PSM‐DID), placebo tests, and alternative sample specifications. Mechanism analysis reveals that the positive impact of government accounting supervision is primarily driven by enhanced supply chain transparency and the suppression of abnormal related‐party transactions. Furthermore, cross‐sectional analyses reveal that this effect is more pronounced in firms with higher supplier concentration or those lacking political connections. Overall, our findings offer important insights into the role of institutional oversight in fostering financial innovation and enhancing supply chain sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政府会计监督对中国上市公司采纳供应链金融（SCF）的影响。采用双重差分法（DID）及覆盖1999年至2022年的综合数据集，我们发现了强有力的证据表明，政府会计监督显著促进了供应链金融的采纳。这一关系在多项稳健性检验中依然稳固，包括平行趋势分析、倾向得分匹配（PSM-DID）、安慰剂检验及替代样本设定。机制分析揭示，政府会计监督的积极影响主要源于供应链透明度的提升及对异常关联方交易的抑制。此外，横截面分析显示，在供应商集中度较高或缺乏政治关联的企业中，这一效应更为显著。总体而言，我们的研究为制度监督在促进金融创新及增强供应链可持续性方面的作用提供了重要见解。

title: Informal Redistribution Through Work
title_zh: 通过工作的非正式再分配
title_primary: 通过工作的非正式再分配
title_secondary: Informal Redistribution Through Work
authors: Elisa Macchi, Jeremia Stalder
official: 官方在线 2025-01-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate work as informal redistribution and the drivers underlying these preferences. In a field experiment in Kampala, Uganda, we find that employers and workers consistently choose work redistribution over cash transfers, both revealing a willingness to pay for work. By randomizing work tasks---including busywork---we show that work production value does not explain work redistribution choices: employers pay for zero marginal product work. Choices are also not explained by relational benefits such as signaling or networking; instead, motivations are normative. Experimental evidence suggests a norm for work redistribution rooted in incentive arguments on the demand side, as employers stop requiring work when recipients have verifiable emergencies, and a combination of reciprocity and dignity from earning on the supply side. This norm impacts the organization of production: firms appear larger and less productive. Effective firm size is 6.4% smaller, and revenues per hour are 9.3% higher when accounting for symbolic work.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了工作作为非正式再分配的形式及其偏好背后的驱动因素。在乌干达坎帕拉的一项实地实验中，我们发现雇主和工人一致选择工作再分配而非现金转移，双方均表现出为工作付费的意愿。通过随机分配工作任务——包括无意义工作——我们证明工作生产价值并不能解释工作再分配的选择：雇主为边际产出为零的工作支付报酬。这些选择也不能由信号传递或社交网络等关系性收益来解释；相反，动机是规范性的。实验证据表明，存在一种基于需求方激励论点的工作再分配规范，当受助者面临可验证的紧急情况时，雇主不再要求工作；而在供给方，则源于互惠和通过劳动获得尊严的结合。这一规范影响了生产组织方式：企业显得规模更大但效率更低。考虑象征性工作后，有效企业规模缩小了6.4%，每小时收入则提高了9.3%。

title: Health perception biases and healthcare utilization in China: a longitudinal approach
title_zh: 中国健康认知偏差与医疗服务利用：一项纵向研究
title_primary: 中国健康认知偏差与医疗服务利用：一项纵向研究
title_secondary: Health perception biases and healthcare utilization in China: a longitudinal approach
authors: Peng Nie, Sonja Spitzer, Alfonso Sousa-Poza
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article investigates the role of health perception biases for healthcare utilization and related expenditure in China, an underexplored context characterized by rapid population ageing and fragmented healthcare coverage. Using panel data on over 17,000 adults from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS), we measure health perception biases as the difference between objective health outcomes from physical examinations and self-reported health. We find that health underestimation is associated with more doctor visits, while health overestimation is correlated with less doctor services. The positive association between underestimation and hospital stays is present in random-effects and correlated random-effects Poisson estimates but is not supported by the FE Poisson estimates. Health perception biases are also strongly associated with total and out-of-pocket expenditures for both outpatient and inpatient care. Importantly, family support – especially the presence of co-resident sons – moderates the association between health underestimation and doctor visits, highlighting the role of family dynamics in healthcare decisions. KEYWORDS: Health perception bias overconfidence underconfidence healthcare utilization China JEL CLASSIFICATION: I12 I18 P46
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了健康认知偏差在中国医疗保健利用及相关支出中的作用，这一背景尚未得到充分研究，其特点是人口快速老龄化和医疗保障覆盖碎片化。利用中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）中超过17，000名成年人的面板数据，我们将健康认知偏差量化为体检得出的客观健康结果与自报健康之间的差异。研究发现，健康低估与更多的就诊次数相关，而健康高估则与较少的医疗服务使用相关。低估与住院之间的正相关关系在随机效应和相关随机效应泊松估计中显著，但固定效应泊松估计未支持这一结果。健康认知偏差还与门诊和住院护理的总支出及自付支出密切相关。重要的是，家庭支持——尤其是与儿子同住——调节了健康低估与就诊次数之间的关联，凸显了家庭动态在医疗保健决策中的作用。关键词：健康认知偏差；过度自信；信心不足；医疗保健利用；中国 JEL分类：I12 I18 P46

title: The role of accounting in the informal economy
title_zh: 会计在非正规经济中的作用
title_primary: 会计在非正规经济中的作用
title_secondary: The role of accounting in the informal economy
authors: M. Aguilar, Gary Lind, K. Ramesh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using novel survey data from 1426 firms in Guatemala, Honduras, and El Salvador, we examine the voluntary adoption of accounting systems by microenterprises operating in the informal economy and its association with access to credit and business growth. Despite the absence of regulatory mandates, 44 percent of informal microbusinesses maintain systematic financial records, with roughly three-quarters of those using notebooks and one-quarter using digital records. Accounting quality is closely linked to the owner’s startup motivation, financial stake, and management capabilities. Informal firms that rely on larger suppliers, extend customer installment credit, engage in marketing promotions, or employ more formal organizational structures are also more likely to adopt structured recordkeeping systems, highlighting accounting’s role as a managerial tool rather than as a compliance function or as a precursor to entering the formal economy. Informal firms that maintain notebooks separating business and personal accounts are significantly more likely to apply for and obtain bank loans. Our inferences for access to credit also extend to microenterprises in the Dominican Republic. In addition, accounting quality appears to support lender due diligence even among informal firms, particularly when lenders are more sophisticated. Using a broader measure of credit market status, we find that accounting quality rises monotonically across credit tiers. Finally, we find that entrepreneurs with higher-quality accounting systems are more likely to plan for business expansion. By illuminating the motivations behind accounting choices in low-enforcement settings, this study deepens our understanding of the foundational role accounting plays in early-stage business development in emerging markets.
abstract_zh: 利用来自危地马拉、洪都拉斯和萨尔瓦多1426家企业的全新调查数据，我们考察了非正规经济中微型企业自愿采用会计制度的情况及其与信贷获取和企业增长之间的关联。尽管缺乏监管强制要求，仍有44%的非正规微型企业保持系统性的财务记录，其中约四分之三使用笔记本记录，四分之一使用数字记录。会计质量与企业主的创业动机、财务投入及管理能力密切相关。依赖较大供应商、向客户提供分期付款信贷、开展营销推广活动或采用更正式组织结构的非正规企业，也更有可能采用结构化的记账系统，这凸显了会计作为管理工具而非合规职能或进入正规经济前提的作用。将企业与个人账户分离记账的非正规企业，申请并获得银行贷款的可能性显著更高。我们关于信贷获取的推论同样适用于多米尼加共和国的微型企业。此外，会计质量似乎即使在非正规企业中也能支持贷方的尽职调查，尤其是在贷方更为专业的情况下。使用更广泛的信贷市场地位衡量指标，我们发现会计质量随信贷层级上升而单调递增。最后，我们发现拥有更高质量会计系统的企业家更有可能规划业务扩张。通过揭示低执法环境下会计选择背后的动机，本研究深化了我们对会计在新兴市场早期企业发展中所发挥基础性作用的理解。

title: Japan’s productivity transformation: From within-firm stagnation to market-driven reallocation
title_zh: 日本生产率转型：从企业内部停滞到市场驱动的再配置
title_primary: 日本生产率转型：从企业内部停滞到市场驱动的再配置
title_secondary: Japan’s productivity transformation: From within-firm stagnation to market-driven reallocation
authors: Kyoji Fukao, YoungGak Kim, Hyeog Ug Kwon
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Discussions on Japan’s ‘lost decades’ have long focused on sluggish demand and the survival of ‘zombie’ firms. However, new evidence from microdata suggests a fundamental shift. This column argues that Japan’s productivity dynamics are moving from internal firm improvements to market-driven reallocation and reveals that the country’s unique ‘negative exit effect’ is largely driven by the mergers and acquisitions activity of high-productivity firms.
abstract_zh: 关于日本“失去的几十年”的讨论，长期以来聚焦于需求疲软和“僵尸”企业的存续。然而，来自微观数据的新证据表明，情况发生了根本性转变。本专栏认为，日本的生产率动态正从企业内部改进转向市场驱动的重新配置，并揭示该国独特的“负退出效应”在很大程度上是由高生产率企业的并购活动所驱动的。

title: The Crypto Cycle and Institutional Investors
title_zh: 加密货币周期与机构投资者
title_primary: 加密货币周期与机构投资者
title_secondary: The Crypto Cycle and Institutional Investors
authors: Alexander Copestake, Davide Furceri, Tammaro Terracciano, Pierre De Leo, Gita Gopinath 等
official: 官方在线 2024-12-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine aggregate fluctuations in crypto markets and their relationship to global equity markets and US monetary policy. First, we document that changes in the correlation between crypto and global equity markets can be explained by changes in the participation of institutional investors in crypto markets. Second, we find that US monetary policy significantly affects crypto markets, but only when the participation of institutional investors is high. Finally, we rationalize our empirical results in a heterogeneous-agent model with time-varying aggregate risk aversion, in which large investors holding both asset classes create a direct link between them.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了加密货币市场的总体波动及其与全球股票市场和美国货币政策的关系。首先，我们记录了加密货币与全球股票市场之间相关性的变化，这可以通过机构投资者在加密货币市场参与度的变化来解释。其次，我们发现美国货币政策显著影响加密货币市场，但仅在机构投资者参与度较高时如此。最后，我们在一个具有时变总体风险厌恶的异质代理人模型中合理化我们的实证结果，在该模型中，持有两类资产的大型投资者在它们之间建立了直接联系。

title: Truth Elicitation in a Nonstrategic Environment
title_zh: 非策略环境中的真实信息诱导
title_primary: 非策略环境中的真实信息诱导
title_secondary: Truth Elicitation in a Nonstrategic Environment
authors: Glazer, Jacob, Rubinstein, Ariel
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: A principal decides which party deserves a prize. Only the parties observe the state that determines who is deserving. The principal gives each party a text describing the conditions under which that party deserves the prize, and asks each to report the state. The parties are nonstrategic. Each activates a known cheating procedure whose outcome depends on the state and on the text. Implementation is achieved if, whenever the parties disagree, the liar is identified by the “one-way cheating principle”: The truthful party is the unique party who could not have produced his story had the rival’s story been true.
abstract_zh: 委托人决定哪一方应获得奖项。只有各方能观察到决定谁应得该奖项的状态。委托人向每一方提供一份描述该方应得奖项条件的文本，并要求各方报告状态。各方不采取策略性行为。每一方激活一个已知的作弊程序，其结果取决于状态和文本。当各方意见不一致时，通过“单向作弊原则”识别说谎者，从而实现实施：诚实方是唯一在对手所述为真时无法编造自己故事的一方。

title: Willingness to accept local CAFO development: actual water quality information and rural residents’ preferences for means of compensation
title_zh: 接受本地集中式动物饲养场开发的意愿：实际水质信息与农村居民补偿方式偏好
title_primary: 接受本地集中式动物饲养场开发的意愿：实际水质信息与农村居民补偿方式偏好
title_secondary: Willingness to accept local CAFO development: actual water quality information and rural residents’ preferences for means of compensation
authors: Xinyue Liu, Li Zhou, Wuyang Hu, Xinqi Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Concentrated animal feeding operations (CAFOs) provide low-cost products but often face local opposition due to environmental externalities. Based on a two-time panel discrete choice experiment (DCE) of rural residents living near CAFOs in China, this study quantifies how water quality information disclosure and various means of compensation affect residents’ acceptance of local CAFO development. The findings reveal that: (1) Compensation programmes incorporating quasi-public goods and environmental offsets can improve residents’ acceptance of CAFOs, with environmental offsets yielding the highest utility to respondents. (2) Water quality information disclosure heightens legitimate risk awareness, increasing the likelihood of opting out and rejecting CAFO construction. When the contribution of crop production to water pollution is clarified, residents receiving favourable water quality testing results show a higher willingness to accept CAFO development than those receiving unfavourable testing results. These results suggest that policymakers should prioritize environmental offsets, strengthen environmental regulation to ensure compliance, and provide the public with objective interpretations of risks. This study offers valuable insights for promoting sustainable CAFO development in China and economies with similar institutional contexts. KEYWORDS: Concentrated animal feeding operations information disclosure means of compensation willingness to accept JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q51 Q53 Q56 Q13
abstract_zh: 集约化畜禽养殖场（CAFOs）提供低成本产品，但常因环境外部性而面临当地居民的反对。基于对中国CAFOs周边农村居民开展的两期面板离散选择实验（DCE），本研究量化了水质信息披露及不同补偿方式对居民接受当地CAFOs开发意愿的影响。研究发现：（1）纳入准公共物品与环境补偿的补偿方案能够提升居民对CAFOs的接受度，其中环境补偿为受访者带来最高效用。（2）水质信息披露增强了居民的合法风险意识，提高了选择退出并拒绝CAFOs建设的可能性。当明确作物生产对水污染的贡献时，获得有利水质检测结果的居民比获得不利检测结果的居民表现出更高的CAFOs开发接受意愿。上述结果表明，政策制定者应优先考虑环境补偿，加强环境监管以确保合规，并向公众提供客观的风险解读。本研究为促进中国及具有相似制度背景的经济体中CAFOs的可持续发展提供了有价值的参考。关键词：集约化畜禽养殖场；信息披露；补偿方式；接受意愿 JEL分类：Q51 Q53 Q56 Q13

title: Central Bank Digital Currency and Monetary Architecture
title_zh: 中央银行数字货币与货币架构
title_primary: 中央银行数字货币与货币架构
title_secondary: Central Bank Digital Currency and Monetary Architecture
authors: Niepelt, Dirk
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We provide a guide to the macroeconomic literature on retail central bank digital currency (CBDC), organizing the discussion around a CBDC-irrelevance result. We identify both fundamental and policy-related sources of relevance, or departures from neutrality. Bank disintermediation—the crowding out of deposits—does not, by itself, constitute such a source. We argue that the literature has primarily focused on policy-related sources of non-neutrality, often without making this focus explicit. From a macroeconomic perspective, CBDC is, at its core, a matter of monetary architecture, and political economy considerations are central to understanding CBDC policy design.
abstract_zh: 本文围绕零售型央行数字货币（CBDC）的宏观经济文献提供指南，并以CBDC无关性结论为核心组织讨论。我们识别了相关性的根本来源与政策相关来源，即对中性状态的偏离。银行去中介化——存款被挤出——本身并不构成此类来源。我们认为，现有文献主要聚焦于非中性的政策相关来源，但往往未明确这一侧重点。从宏观经济视角看，CBDC本质上属于货币架构问题，而政治经济学考量对于理解CBDC政策设计至关重要。

title: DP774 The Political Economy of the Exchange Rate Mechanism
title_zh: 汇率机制的政治经济学
title_primary: 汇率机制的政治经济学
title_secondary: DP774 The Political Economy of the Exchange Rate Mechanism
authors: Patrick Minford
official: 官方在线 1993-03-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explains this phenomenon in terms of a `peso problem' of credibility created by the response of a member government to the incentives it faces within the ERM.A country within the ERM that attempts to restrain inflation and avoid economic distortions faces strong pressure from its domestic manufacturing lobby. In the event that trading conditions for manufacturers worsen drastically, they will apply intense pressure not only for subsidy protection but also for a devaluation. When times are good, however, the pressure will be relaxed. This creates an asymmetry in the government's policy reaction: devaluation and subsidy in bad times, and no parity change or subsidy in good times. The result is an average expectation of devaluation in excess of what normally occurs which leads to overvaluation in normal times.
abstract_zh: 本文从“比索问题”的视角解释这一现象，该问题源于成员国政府在欧洲汇率机制（ERM）内所面临的激励所引发的可信度危机。在ERM中，试图抑制通胀并避免经济扭曲的成员国，会面临来自国内制造业游说集团的强大压力。当制造业贸易条件急剧恶化时，这些集团不仅会强烈要求补贴保护，还会施压要求货币贬值。然而，在经济形势良好时，这种压力会有所缓解。这导致政府政策反应出现不对称性：经济低迷时期采取贬值和补贴措施，而经济繁荣时期则维持汇率不变且不提供补贴。其结果是，市场对贬值的平均预期高于实际发生频率，从而在正常时期造成汇率高估。

title: No-Poach Agreements
title_zh: 禁止挖角协议
title_primary: 禁止挖角协议
title_secondary: No-Poach Agreements
authors: Axel Gottfries, Gregor Jarosch

abstract: We study no-poach cartels using a wage-posting model that puts worker poaching at the center of labor market competition. Even when just two out of ten employers in a local labor market collude, wages fall by almost 5% market-wide. The reason is that no-poach agreements suppress competition along the job ladder, with spillovers to non-colluding firms. We then compare no-poach agreements to two other forms of anti-competitive conduct in the labor market: noncompete agreements and wage fixing. No-poach agreements have by far the largest negative wage effects.

abstract: When exactly does a preference ordering on acts have an additive state-dependent utility representation per indifference curve? Following the analogy of a sliding balance, a perfect reflection of the well-known betweenness models for lotteries, we find three answers for monetary acts on a finite state space. In the first two, we exploit the axiom of weak decomposability, identified by Grant, Kajii, and Polak (2000) as the key axiom to extend betweenness to acts, but leaving the continuity and monotonicity of state utility in setpoints an open issue. Our first theorem confirms the necessity of continuity, while the second shows that monotonicty in setpoints requires the additional axiom of ratio monotonicity . It formalises the idea that sliding a setpoint towards a gain decreases its momentum compared to losses. This observation, in turn, suggests to extend the primitive of a preference ordering with a benchmark for discerning gains from losses within an act. Thus we arrive at the Additive Sliding Balance Utility model for orderings anchored to such a benchmark. In the third theorem, we characterise this class with an even more straightforward betweenness axiom: the balance point of an act should be in between those of its parts.
abstract_zh: 在何种精确条件下，行动上的偏好序能够为每条无差异曲线提供加性状态依赖效用表示？遵循滑动平衡的类比——这一概念完美反映了彩票理论中著名的中间性模型——我们针对有限状态空间上的货币行动给出了三种解答。前两种解答中，我们运用了格兰特、梶井与波拉克（2000）所识别的弱可分解性公理，该公理被视为将中间性扩展至行动的关键，但状态效用关于设定点的连续性与单调性仍为开放问题。第一定理证实了连续性的必要性，而第二定理表明设定点单调性需要额外引入比率单调性公理。该公理形式化了如下思想：将设定点向收益方向滑动会降低其相对于损失的动量。这一观察进而提示，应在偏好序的原始概念中引入一个基准，用以区分行动内部的收益与损失。由此，我们提出了针对锚定此类基准的序关系的加性滑动平衡效用模型。在第三定理中，我们通过一个更为直接的中间性公理刻画了该模型类别：行动的平衡点应介于其各组成部分的平衡点之间。

abstract: This paper investigates how marginal utility varies with health status (e.g. health-state dependence) while allowing this relationship to differ across income levels. Building on the existing literature, we develop a framework that quantifies the income adjustments necessary to maintain individuals’ wellbeing when they become disabled. Using SHARE data, we empirically estimate how health affects the marginal utility of consumption across the income distribution for older adults in Europe. Our results show that health-state dependence is negative among low-income individuals, indicating that their marginal utility of consumption declines when their health worsens. In contrast, at the very top of the income distribution, health-state dependence is positive, implying that marginal utility of consumption rises as health deteriorates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了边际效用如何随健康状况变化（即健康状态依赖性），并允许这种关系在不同收入水平上存在差异。在现有文献基础上，我们构建了一个框架，用以量化个体在残疾时维持其福祉所需的收入调整。利用SHARE数据，我们实证估计了健康如何影响欧洲老年人消费边际效用的收入分布差异。研究结果表明，低收入群体的健康状态依赖性为负，即其健康状况恶化时消费边际效用下降。相反，在收入分布顶端，健康状态依赖性为正，意味着健康状况恶化时消费边际效用上升。

title: An axiomatization of the smooth ambiguity model using differentiability

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The smooth ambiguity model (Klibanoff et al., 2005) or second-order subjective expected utility (SOSEU) model (Nau, 2006; Seo, 2009; Giraud, 2014) has two characteristics that contribute to its success: it is an iterated expected utility and, under certain conditions, it is smooth. These characteristics allow for the use of standard analytical techniques from expected utility theory, including optimization calculus. In this paper, we utilize the continuous differentiability ( C 1 ) of the SOSEU functional to offer an axiomatic characterization of this model. First, we define C 1 preferences and provide a representation for them. Then, assuming that preferences are C 1 , the primary axiom that delivers the iterated expected utility form essentially states that if decision makers are more sensitive to perturbations of one portfolio of assets than another one when the probability distribution is known, then they are still more sensitive when it is not.
abstract_zh: 平滑模糊模型（Klibanoff等，2005）或二阶主观期望效用（SOSEU）模型（Nau，2006；Seo，2009；Giraud，2014）具有两个促使其成功的特征：它是一个迭代期望效用，并且在特定条件下是平滑的。这些特征使得能够运用期望效用理论中的标准分析技术，包括优化微积分。本文利用SOSEU泛函的连续可微性（C¹），为该模型提供了一种公理化刻画。首先，我们定义了C¹偏好并为其提供了表示。然后，假设偏好是C¹的，实现迭代期望效用形式的主要公理实质上表明：如果在概率分布已知的情况下，决策者对某一资产组合的扰动比另一资产组合更为敏感，那么在概率分布未知时，他们依然会更为敏感。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The bibliometric analysis delves into the progression and influence of research concerning the quality of tourism, emphasizing the patterns, inputs, and thematic advancements within the domain. According to the study, conference papers provide a lesser percentage of insightful material than journal articles, which indicates a strong emphasis on peer-reviewed research and accounts for the majority of relevant literature. Since 1983, the field of study has changed dramatically. Notable growth began in the late 1990s and peaked in the most recent years, indicating a rise in scholarly interest in high-quality tourism. Important journals like "The Journal of Quality Assurance in Hospitality and Tourism," "Sustainability Switzerland," and "Tourism Management," are crucial in influencing the conversation. Keywords that stand out are "quality of life," "tourism," and "sustainability," with an emphasis on global viewpoints, particularly as they relate to China. The field has advanced thanks to significant contributions from people like Carneiro, Eusébio, and Uysal as well as organizations like Universidade Q9 and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Strong international cooperation is highlighted by the citation network, which shows strong connections between China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Portugal. The study emphasizes a multidisciplinary strategy that integrates environmental and managerial factors into the quality of tourism. Although the study offers a thorough overview, its limitations include methodological issues, temporal and linguistic biases, and dependence on particular data sources. All things considered, the analysis presents a vibrant and cooperative field characterized by significant scholarly involvement and an increasing focus on sustainability and interdisciplinary research.
abstract_zh: 文献计量分析深入探讨了旅游质量研究的进展与影响力，重点关注该领域的模式、投入及主题演进。研究表明，会议论文提供的洞察性材料占比低于期刊论文，这表明同行评审研究受到高度重视，并构成了相关文献的主体。自1983年以来，该研究领域发生了显著变化。显著增长始于20世纪90年代末，并在最近几年达到顶峰，反映出学术界对高质量旅游的兴趣日益浓厚。《酒店与旅游质量保证期刊》、《瑞士可持续发展》和《旅游管理》等重要期刊在引导学术讨论中发挥了关键作用。突出的关键词包括“生活质量”、“旅游”和“可持续性”，尤其关注全球视角，特别是与中国相关的研究。Carneiro、Eusébio和Uysal等学者以及Universidade Q9和香港理工大学等机构为该领域的进步做出了重要贡献。引文网络凸显了强大的国际合作，显示中国、美国、英国、西班牙和葡萄牙之间存在紧密联系。研究强调了一种跨学科策略，将环境和管理因素融入旅游质量中。尽管该研究提供了全面的概述，但其局限性包括方法论问题、时间与语言偏差，以及对特定数据源的依赖。总体而言，该分析呈现了一个充满活力且协作性强的领域，其特点是显著的学术参与度，以及对可持续性和跨学科研究的日益关注。

authors: Agnieszka Głodowska, Agnieszka Hajdukiewicz, Bożena Pera, Csaba Weiner
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the impact of the European Union's post‐March 2014 and post‐February 2022 sanctions episodes against Russia on trade between Russia and the Visegrad countries (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia) over 2013–2024. Changes are analysed at both the aggregate level and—based on an original identification of EU sanction coverage—across selected sanctioned product chapters and non‐sanctioned reference groups. The empirical framework combines descriptive statistics on the distribution of the selected product groups with two complementary econometric approaches: a gravity‐based Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood model (PPML) with fixed effects, estimated in a difference‐in‐differences design relative to control markets, and a PPML interrupted time‐series model used as a robustness check to identify structural breaks and post‐intervention trends. Empirically, the effects of EU sanctions on Visegrad exports to Russia were strongly negative already under the post‐March 2014 sanctions regime, particularly for highly sanctioned manufactured product groups such as machinery and electrical equipment, and intensified further following the substantial expansion of sanctions after February 2022. Import effects were initially weaker but intensified markedly from 2022 onward, most notably for energy sources. The findings point to episode‐specific trade responses, pronounced heterogeneity across product groups, and a clear asymmetry between export and import adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2013—2024年间，欧盟在2014年3月后及2022年2月后对俄罗斯实施的两轮制裁对俄罗斯与维谢格拉德国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）之间贸易的影响。分析涵盖总体层面，并基于对欧盟制裁覆盖范围的原创识别，在选定的受制裁产品章节和未受制裁参考组之间展开。实证框架结合了所选产品组分布的描述性统计与两种互补的计量经济学方法：一是基于引力模型的泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）固定效应模型，采用双重差分设计相对于对照市场进行估计；二是作为稳健性检验的PPML中断时间序列模型，用于识别结构断点和干预后趋势。实证结果显示，早在2014年3月后的制裁体制下，欧盟制裁对维谢格拉德国家向俄罗斯的出口已产生强烈负面影响，尤其对机械和电气设备等受高度制裁的制成品组影响显著，并在2022年2月后制裁大幅扩展后进一步加剧。进口影响最初较弱，但从2022年起显著增强，最突出的是能源类产品。研究结果揭示了针对不同制裁事件的贸易反应差异、产品组间的显著异质性，以及出口与进口调整之间的明显不对称性。

title: Can Innovation Policies Enhance Export Sophistication? Evidence From China
title_zh: 创新政策能否提升出口复杂度？来自中国的证据

authors: Lili Li, Jiahong Dou, Yiwu Zeng
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Based on panel data of China's urban trade exports from 2006 to 2023, this study employs the National Innovative City Pilot (NICP) policy as a quasi-natural experiment and adopts a Time-varying Difference-in-differences approach to investigate the impact of innovation policies on urban export sophistication. The findings reveal that the NICP policy significantly enhances urban export sophistication, validating the positive efficacy of innovation policies in China's export sector. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy promotes urban export sophistication by optimising urban infrastructure, stimulating technological innovation and advancing industrial structure upgrading. Furthermore, the empowering effect of this policy is more pronounced in late-developing cities, especially in the less-developed western regions, small and medium-sized cities and cities with relatively scarce resource endowments. This study also explores the synergistic effects between the Low-Carbon City Policy and the NICP policy, as well as between the Broadband China Policy and the NICP policy, finding that these policy synergies further enhance urban export sophistication. The research enriches the literature on urban export sophistication and provides valuable insights for China and other countries in refining policy design and implementation, as well as urban planning and development to boost export sophistication and foster foreign trade growth.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2006至2023年中国城市贸易出口的面板数据，以创新型城市试点政策作为准自然实验，采用时变双重差分法探讨了创新政策对城市出口复杂度的影响。研究发现，创新型城市试点政策显著提升了城市出口复杂度，验证了创新政策在中国出口领域的积极效能。机制分析表明，该政策通过优化城市基础设施、激发技术创新及推动产业结构升级，进而促进城市出口复杂度的提升。此外，该政策的赋能效应在欠发达城市中更为显著，尤其是在发展较落后的西部地区、中小城市及资源禀赋相对匮乏的城市中表现突出。本研究还探讨了低碳城市政策与创新型城市试点政策之间，以及宽带中国政策与创新型城市试点政策之间的协同效应，发现这些政策协同进一步增强了城市出口复杂度。本研究丰富了关于城市出口复杂度的文献，并为中国及其他国家在完善政策设计与实施、以及城市发展规划以提升出口复杂度和促进外贸增长方面提供了有价值的参考。

title: Uncertainty and the term structure of interest rates
title_zh: 不确定性与利率期限结构
title_primary: 不确定性与利率期限结构
title_secondary: Uncertainty and the term structure of interest rates
authors: Jamie L. Cross, Aubrey Poon, Dan Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document a new stylized fact linking uncertainty to the term structure of interest rates: unanticipated increases in uncertainty generate a yield curve that is lower, steeper, and less curved. Using a Yields-Macro Dynamic Nelson–Siegel model applied to U.S. Treasury yields, uncertainty measures, and macroeconomic aggregates, we show that this result is robust across financial, macroeconomic, and policy-related sources of uncertainty. A stylized asset-pricing model provides a structural interpretation, tracing these effects to precautionary motives under investor prudence. Counterfactual analyses show that uncertainty lowers the expected path of short rates while raising term premia, consistent with precautionary and risk-compensation mechanisms. We also develop an efficient Bayesian algorithm for estimating Yields-Macro Dynamic Nelson–Siegel models with constant or time-varying exponential decay parameters.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了一个将不确定性与利率期限结构联系起来的新典型事实：未预期到的不确定性上升会导致收益率曲线更低、更陡峭且弯曲程度更小。通过将Yields-Macro动态Nelson–Siegel模型应用于美国国债收益率、不确定性指标及宏观经济总量，我们表明这一结果在金融、宏观经济和政策相关的不确定性来源中均具有稳健性。一个简约的资产定价模型提供了结构性解释，将这些效应追溯至投资者审慎性下的预防性动机。反事实分析显示，不确定性降低了短期利率的预期路径，同时提高了期限溢价，这与预防性机制和风险补偿机制相一致。我们还开发了一种高效的贝叶斯算法，用于估计具有恒定或时变指数衰减参数的Yields-Macro动态Nelson–Siegel模型。

title: Lucky but confident –The effect of confidence on meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution
title_zh: 幸运但自信——自信对精英信念与再分配偏好的影响
title_primary: 幸运但自信——自信对精英信念与再分配偏好的影响
title_secondary: Lucky but confident –The effect of confidence on meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution
authors: Kajsa Hansson, Oda Kristine Storstad Sund
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How does confidence in combination with success affect meritocratic beliefs and preferences for redistribution? In a large-scale real-effort competition (n = 1365), we manipulate both confidence and the outcome of the competition to provide causal evidence. First, we show that increased confidence causes successful participants to perceive outcomes as more meritocratic, while unsuccessful participants perceive outcomes as more determined by luck. Thus, increased confidence polarizes meritocratic beliefs between successful and unsuccessful individuals. Second, we find no statistically significant effect of confidence on preferences for redistribution. However, we do find that winning the competition significantly reduces the willingness to redistribute, regardless of confidence treatment. Our findings suggest that disagreements about the causes of inequality are most likely among individuals who anticipate success in a meritocratic system, and that success and failure can have large polarizing effects on preferences for redistribution.
abstract_zh: 信心与成功如何共同影响人们对精英主义的信念及再分配偏好？在一项大规模真实努力竞赛中（样本量n=1365），我们同时操控信心与竞赛结果，以提供因果证据。首先，我们表明，信心的增强导致成功参与者更倾向于将结果视为精英主义所致，而失败参与者则更倾向于认为结果由运气决定。因此，信心的增强在成功与失败个体之间加剧了精英主义信念的两极分化。其次，我们发现信心对再分配偏好无统计学显著影响。然而，我们确实发现，无论信心处理如何，赢得竞赛显著降低了再分配的意愿。我们的研究结果表明，关于不平等根源的分歧最可能出现在那些预期在精英主义体系中取得成功的人群中，而成功与失败可能对再分配偏好产生巨大的极化效应。

title: Shocks, Agricultural Productivity, Self‐Help Groups and Food Security in Tanzania
title_zh: 冲击、农业生产力、自助小组与坦桑尼亚的粮食安全
title_primary: 冲击、农业生产力、自助小组与坦桑尼亚的粮食安全
title_secondary: Shocks, Agricultural Productivity, Self‐Help Groups and Food Security in Tanzania
authors: Francisco M. P. Mugizi, Rayner Tabetando, Djomo Choumbou Raoul Fani
official: 官方在线 2026-03-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates whether negative shocks constrain agricultural productivity and household food security. It also examines the mitigating role of Savings and Credit Cooperative Societies (SACCOS) and self‐help groups (SHGs) in cushioning households against the adverse effects of shocks on agricultural productivity and food security. Using nationally representative panel data from Tanzania and household fixed effects, the results reveal that negative shocks significantly reduce productivity. When disaggregating by type, we find that weather‐related and covariate shocks exert larger negative effects than idiosyncratic shocks. Heterogeneity analysis shows that land‐poor and poor households are more severely affected than land‐rich and non‐poor households. Shocks also reduce food security in Tanzania, with results robust across multiple measures, shock types, and household subsamples, that is, poor and non‐poor households. Furthermore, the results reveal that neither SACCOS membership nor membership in SHGs has a significant mitigating effect on agricultural productivity or food security.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了负面冲击是否制约农业生产力和家庭粮食安全，并进一步考察了储蓄信贷合作社（SACCOS）和自助团体（SHGs）在缓解冲击对农业生产力和粮食安全不利影响方面的作用。利用坦桑尼亚具有全国代表性的面板数据及家庭固定效应模型，研究结果显示，负面冲击显著降低了生产力。按冲击类型细分后发现，天气相关冲击和共同冲击对生产力的负面影响大于个体特定冲击。异质性分析表明，土地匮乏家庭和贫困家庭受冲击影响的程度比土地充裕家庭和非贫困家庭更为严重。冲击同样降低了坦桑尼亚的粮食安全水平，且这一结果在多种衡量指标、冲击类型及家庭子样本（即贫困与非贫困家庭）中均保持稳健。此外，研究还发现，无论是SACCOS成员资格还是SHGs成员资格，在缓解农业生产力和粮食安全冲击方面均未发挥显著的缓冲作用。

title: Did the Cold War produce development clusters in Africa?
title_zh: 冷战是否在非洲催生了发展集群？
title_primary: 冷战是否在非洲催生了发展集群？
title_secondary: Did the Cold War produce development clusters in Africa?
authors: Paul Castañeda Dower, Gunes Gokmen, Michel Le Breton, Shlomo Weber
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the lasting impact of Cold War alignment on African development. To overcome the empirical challenge of ambiguous and interdependent international alliances during the Cold War, we introduce a non-cooperative game of social interactions. Using pre-determined, country-level characteristics to construct payoffs, we identify a unique two-bloc equilibrium partition of the continent. We then assign bloc alignments based on how the partition predicts UN voting patterns. Our empirical results indicate no income differences today between the Western and the Eastern blocs. However, their development paths reflect Cold War ideologies: Western-aligned African countries have greater inequality, financial development, and democracy, but lesser infrastructure, compared to Eastern-aligned ones.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了冷战时期阵营归属对非洲发展的持久影响。为克服冷战期间国际联盟模糊且相互依存的实证挑战，我们引入了一个非合作的社会互动博弈模型。利用预先确定的国别层面特征来构建收益，我们识别出非洲大陆一个独特的双阵营均衡划分。随后，我们根据该划分对联合国投票模式的预测来分配阵营归属。实证结果显示，今日西方阵营与东方阵营之间的收入并无差异。然而，它们的发展路径反映了冷战意识形态：与东方阵营相比，西方阵营的非洲国家不平等程度更高、金融发展更深入、民主程度更高，但基础设施相对薄弱。

title: High-Dimensional Quantile Vector Autoregression with Influencers and Communities
title_zh: 高维分位数向量自回归：影响者与社区结构
title_primary: 高维分位数向量自回归：影响者与社区结构
title_secondary: High-Dimensional Quantile Vector Autoregression with Influencers and Communities
authors: Shiwei Huang, Karen Ma, Yu Chen
official: 官方在线 2025-12-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Quantile vector autoregression (QVAR) models offer enhanced capabilities over vector autoregression (VAR) models in analyzing asymmetric interactions within multiple time series and are widely used in many areas, including finance and economics. However, in scenarios involving high-dimensional data where the number of time series N exceeds the length of the time series T, both parameter estimation and the theoretical establishment present significant challenges. Notably, existing research has not yet explored these challenges with the framework of QVAR models. To handle this problem, we propose a novel high-dimensional QVAR model that incorporates influencers and communities, which assumes that variables within distinct communities have shared dependency structures and are influenced by the same set of variables, called influencers. We develop an estimation procedure based on the alternating minimization algorithm and the convolution-smoothed approach. The local consistency results for the estimated parameters are established in high-dimensional settings with sub-Weibull innovations. Numerical studies illustrate that the proposed model performs well in finite samples. The proposed model is applied to identify the most influential macroeconomic variables in the United States across business cycles and construct a dynamic quantile network with influencers and communities for volatility spillover effects of global stock markets.
abstract_zh: 分位数向量自回归（QVAR）模型相较于向量自回归（VAR）模型，在分析多元时间序列中的非对称交互作用方面具有更强的能力，并广泛应用于金融和经济学等多个领域。然而，在高维数据场景下，当时间序列数量N超过时间序列长度T时，参数估计和理论构建均面临显著挑战。值得注意的是，现有研究尚未在QVAR模型框架内探讨这些挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的高维QVAR模型，该模型纳入影响者与社群结构，假设不同社群内的变量具有共享的依赖结构，并受同一组变量（称为影响者）的影响。我们开发了一种基于交替最小化算法和卷积平滑方法的估计程序。在高维设置下，针对次Weibull创新项，我们建立了估计参数的局部一致性结果。数值研究表明，所提出的模型在有限样本中表现良好。该模型被应用于识别美国商业周期中最具影响力的宏观经济变量，并构建一个包含影响者与社群的动态分位数网络，以分析全球股票市场的波动溢出效应。

title: Central banker to the world: Foreign reserve management and U.S. money market liquidity
title_zh: 全球央行：外汇储备管理与美国货币市场流动性
title_primary: 全球央行：外汇储备管理与美国货币市场流动性
title_secondary: Central banker to the world: Foreign reserve management and U.S. money market liquidity
authors: Ron Alquist, R. Jay Kahn, Karlye Dilts Stedman
official: 官方在线 2025-12-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a model that shows how foreign reserve management decisions can adversely affect U.S. money market liquidity. Consistent with the March 2020 dash-for-cash, our model suggests that as export-price volatility increases, a foreign central bank that pegs its exchange rate shifts reserves from relatively illiquid Treasuries to the Fed’s reverse repo facility. Over the relevant horizon, this precautionary behavior drains liquidity from U.S. money markets and raises repo spreads. These predictions provide a credible channel to identify the effect of foreign central bank demand for dollar liquidity on repo spreads, exploiting the characteristics of commodity exporters with pegged exchange rates. Empirical evidence supports the model’s predictions: precautionary sales by these central banks lead to a statistically and economically significant widening of repo spreads, accompanied by a drawdown in Treasury balances. These results underscore how the Fed’s foreign-repo facilities mitigate global dollar-funding stress and protect U.S. short-term funding markets.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，展示外汇储备管理决策如何对美元货币市场流动性产生不利影响。与2020年3月的“现金争夺”现象一致，我们的模型表明，随着出口价格波动性增加，实行汇率盯住制度的外国央行会将其储备从相对缺乏流动性的美国国债转向美联储的逆回购工具。在相关时间范围内，这种预防性行为会抽干美国货币市场的流动性，并推高回购利差。这些预测提供了一个可信的渠道，用以识别外国央行对美元流动性需求对回购利差的影响，利用的是实行盯住汇率制的商品出口国的特征。实证证据支持模型的预测：这些央行的预防性抛售导致回购利差在统计和经济意义上显著扩大，同时伴随美国国债余额的减少。这些结果强调了美联储的外国回购便利如何缓解全球美元融资压力，并保护美国短期融资市场。

title: A Loan You Can’t Refuse: Credit Rationing and Organized Crime Infiltration of Distressed Firms
title_zh: 无法拒绝的贷款：信贷配给与困境企业中有组织犯罪的渗透
title_primary: 无法拒绝的贷款：信贷配给与困境企业中有组织犯罪的渗透
title_secondary: A Loan You Can’t Refuse: Credit Rationing and Organized Crime Infiltration of Distressed Firms
authors: Gianmarco Daniele, Marco De Simoni, Domenico J. Marchetti, Giovanna Marcolongo, Paolo Pinotti
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that credit constraints significantly increase the risk that firms are infiltrated by organized crime, defined as the covert involvement of criminal organizations in corporate decision-making. Using confidential data on criminal investigations, credit ratings, and loan histories for the universe of Italian firms, we find that a downgrade to substandard credit status reduces credit availability by 30% over five years and increases the probability of infiltration by 5%, relative to comparable firms. A local randomization design comparing firms just above and below the downgrade threshold confirms this result. The effect is pervasive across sectors and regions, but particularly strong in real estate, where the probability of infiltration rises by 10% following a downgrade. Infiltrated firms also display higher survival rates than other downgraded firms, despite similar declines in employment and revenues. These findings suggest that organized crime can serve as a financial backstop — sustaining non-viable businesses and potentially redirecting their strategies to serve criminal interests.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，信贷约束显著增加了企业被有组织犯罪渗透的风险——即犯罪组织秘密介入企业决策。基于意大利全体企业的刑事调查、信用评级及贷款历史机密数据，我们发现：相较于可比企业，信用评级降至次级标准的企业五年内信贷可得性下降30%，被渗透概率上升5%。采用降级阈值附近企业的局部随机化设计验证了这一结果。该效应普遍存在于各行业与地区，但在房地产领域尤为显著——降级后该行业企业被渗透概率上升10%。尽管被渗透企业与其它降级企业同样面临就业与收入下滑，但其存活率更高。这些发现表明，有组织犯罪可充当财务后盾——维持无生存能力的企业运营，并可能引导其战略转向服务于犯罪利益。

title: Horizontal ecological compensation and Labour share of income within enterprises: evidence from China
title_zh: 横向生态补偿与企业劳动收入份额：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 横向生态补偿与企业劳动收入份额：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Horizontal ecological compensation and Labour share of income within enterprises: evidence from China
authors: Huange Xu, Bo Chen, Guangchen Li, Chuanyu Peng
official: 官方在线 2025-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using the horizontal ecological compensation policy (HECP) as a quasi-natural experiment and data from Chinese A-share listed companies from 2008–2019, we examine the impact of HECP on the labour share of income within enterprises. Compared with the control group, HECP increases the labour share of income in the treated group by 1.03% points. Notably, this policy does not result in a pass-through effect between employee wages and benefits. Mechanism analysis indicates that HECP not only suppresses capital deepening within enterprises but also increases the input of labour factors and improves the structure of human capital, thus fostering an innovation substitution effect and ultimately increasing the labour share of income within enterprises. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that HECP is particularly effective for low-tax-burden enterprises, enterprises in regions with abundant labour resources, and enterprises facing less fiscal pressure. Furthermore, a series of robustness tests confirm the validity of our findings. This study offers a new explanation for understanding the dynamics of China’s labour share of income and provides policy insights for improving horizontal ecological compensation to optimize the labour capital distribution.
abstract_zh: 以横向生态补偿政策（HECP）作为准自然实验，利用2008-2019年中国A股上市公司数据，我们考察了HECP对企业劳动收入份额的影响。与对照组相比，HECP使处理组的劳动收入份额提高了1.03个百分点。值得注意的是，该政策并未在员工工资与福利之间产生传导效应。机制分析表明，HECP不仅抑制了企业内部的资本深化，还增加了劳动要素投入并改善了人力资本结构，从而促进了创新替代效应，最终提高了企业内部的劳动收入份额。异质性分析显示，HECP对低税负企业、劳动力资源丰富地区的企业以及财政压力较小的企业尤为有效。此外，一系列稳健性检验证实了我们研究结果的有效性。本研究为理解中国劳动收入份额的动态变化提供了新的解释，并为完善横向生态补偿以优化劳动资本分配提供了政策启示。

title: Behavioral responses to inheritance taxes: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 遗产税的行为反应：来自巴西的证据
title_primary: 遗产税的行为反应：来自巴西的证据
title_secondary: Behavioral responses to inheritance taxes: Evidence from Brazil
authors: Gedeao Locks
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I examine behavioral responses to inheritance and gift taxes in a setting where individuals knew the tax would increase three months before the new tax code took effect. Using tax microdata from Brazil, I employ bunching and difference-in-differences (DD) methods and find that individuals significantly retime their wealth transfers to avoid taxes. Retimed gifts resulted in smaller inheritances for nearly three years. Moreover, I find that responses are sensitive to changes in top gift marginal tax rates and tax design (flat rates vs progressive brackets). Finally, evasion increased in the medium run in reform states, particularly among small inheritances.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在个人知晓遗产税与赠与税将在三个月后上调的背景下，其行为反应。利用巴西的税收微观数据，采用聚束分析与双重差分法，发现个人显著调整财富转移时间以规避税负。调整后的赠与行为导致近三年内遗产规模缩小。此外，研究显示，行为反应对最高赠与边际税率变动及税制设计（统一税率与累进税率）具有敏感性。最后，改革州的中期逃税行为有所增加，尤以小额遗产为甚。

title: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
title_zh: ChatGPT能否预测股价变动？收益可预测性与大型语言模型
title_primary: ChatGPT能否预测股价变动？收益可预测性与大型语言模型
title_secondary: Can ChatGPT forecast stock price movements? Return predictability and large language models
authors: Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Yuehua Tang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2023-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document the capability of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT to predict stock market reactions from news headlines without direct financial training. Using post-knowledge-cutoff headlines, GPT-4 captures initial market responses, achieving approximately 90% portfolio-day hit rates for the non-tradable initial reaction. GPT-4 scores also significantly predict the subsequent drift, especially for small stocks and negative news. Forecasting ability generally increases with model size, suggesting that financial reasoning is an emerging capacity of complex LLMs. Strategy returns decline as LLM adoption rises, consistent with improved price efficiency. To rationalize these findings, we develop a theoretical model that incorporates LLM technology, information-processing capacity constraints, underreaction, and limits to arbitrage.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了大型语言模型（LLMs）如ChatGPT在无需直接金融训练的情况下，从新闻标题预测股市反应的能力。利用知识截止日期后的标题，GPT-4捕捉到了市场的初始反应，对于不可交易的初始反应实现了约90%的投资组合日命中率。GPT-4的评分还能显著预测随后的漂移，尤其是对于小盘股和负面新闻。预测能力通常随模型规模增大而增强，这表明金融推理是复杂LLMs的一种新兴能力。随着LLM采用的增加，策略回报下降，这与价格效率提升相一致。为合理化这些发现，我们构建了一个理论模型，该模型整合了LLM技术、信息处理能力限制、反应不足以及套利限制。
